explanation:
Choice C is correct. The function $g$ is defined by $g(x) = |x - 6x|$. Substituting $3$ for $x$ yields $g(3) = |3 - 6(3)| = |-15| = 15$. Substituting $a$ for $x$ yields $g(a) = |a - 6a| = |-5a|$. Substituting these into $g(3) - g(a) = -20$ gives $15 - |-5a| = -20$. Subtracting $15$ from both sides yields $-|-5a| = -35$, so $|-5a| = 35$. By the definition of absolute value, $-5a = 35$ or $-5a = -35$, giving $a = -7$ or $a = 7$. Of the given choices, $7$ satisfies the equation.

Why B is incorrect:

Choice B is incorrect. This is the value substituted into $g(3)$, not a value of $a$ that satisfies the equation $g(3) - g(a) = -20$.
